name: Shimada Eriko
source:
One of [url=https://vndb.org/c33073]Makoto's[/url] best friends.
She is the daughter of a high class family and her fiancé, Masaki, was chosen by her family. Whenever asked about her relationship and sex life she always replies that it is a secret.
She has huge breast which she has a complex about.
